def: properly, something very smooth; i.e. a treacherous spot; figuratively, blandishment

words.word: shall be unto them as slippery

occurrences.text: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the Lord persecute them.
Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the Lord.
words: shall be unto them as slippery
